neighbours.label: 'to' marking the end state of a change ('from X to Y', 'changes ... to'), not plain direction or infinitive 'to'
fire: The light on the panel switched from green to red without warning.
Over the decade, the town's population grew from 5,000 to 12,000.
His mood shifted slowly from anger to quiet acceptance.
The ticket status was updated from pending to approved overnight.
Water turns from liquid to vapor when it boils.
Her salary went up from 40,000 to 55,000 after the promotion.
The order moved from processing to shipped this morning.
In autumn the leaves change from green to deep orange.
quiet: The light on the panel switched off without warning.
Over the decade, the town's population grew very quickly.
His mood shifted slowly as the evening went on.
The ticket status was updated by the manager overnight.
Water boils faster when the pot has a lid.
Her salary went up sharply after the promotion.
The order was ready to ship this morning.
In autumn the leaves fall onto the wet grass.

predictions: Fires on ' to' after 'from X' in changes of state or amount; quiet on infinitive and destination 'to' and on change verbs without 'to'.
notes: Broad pole (1.2%). Probes: 'from queued to running' 0.32, 'doubled from 400 million to 900 million' 0.28, 'increases from interest to joy' 0.43, all peaking on ' to'; 'withdrew back to a border' 0.11; 'rose sharply' 0.02, 'fell sharply' 0.03.
